title: •Wookiee Guide
caption: •Wookiee Guide (V)
game_text: Stack a Wookiee from your Lost Pile on Grrrghrrrgh!. OR Deploy a Wookiee stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! to Kashyyyk (as if from hand). OR Once per game, draw X cards from top of Reserve deck, where X = number of cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!.
lore: Chewie felt right at home in the forests of Endor, which closely resemble the environment on his homeworld of Kashyyyk.

notes: Group (sheet sub-heading): Battle Of Kashyyyk. Unique. Banner USED INTERRUPT. Right margin: black EPISODE I disc above the set sphere → icons ['episode1'] (not on the printed card). The slip prints 'Reserve deck' (lower-case d; text layer agrees) — the stub has 'Reserve Deck'. Lore matches the wiki and the PC's 745 px V16 remake. 350 px base scan; Endor 1999 copyright. Modern: V16-L-wookieeguide.gif (745, the PC's later modern Wookiee Guide, same art/lore, different text) and VB5-L-wookieeguide-pre.gif (350).
